biography.value: Wave Breakers use Water Jet to clear lines and apply cold conditions, then close to melee. Engulf is their best option — used on a single priority target when the angle appears. In water they are substantially faster and more capable. A summoner who draws enemies near a water source before a Wave Breaker surfaces will find the encounter resolved more efficiently than the TR suggests is reasonable.

system.attacksNotes:
Crashing Slam [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 5 + Melee Combat 3), Reach: 10 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 9 damage (2 + 7 Str) + 3 cold damage (Half DR); target pushed 5 feet.
  • Margin 2: 9 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 cold damage; target pushed 10 feet and knocked Prone; no save.
  • Margin 3: 9 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 cold damage + Prone; target gains Numbed condition.

Water Jet [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 4 + Ranged Combat 2), Range: 30 ft, 5-foot-wide line

  • Margin 1:: 12 cold damage (8 + 4 Dex); creatures in line make Fortitude [Easy] save or pushed 10 feet.
  • Margin 2: 12 cold damage, DR halved (round up); pushed 15 feet; no save.
  • Margin 3: 12 cold damage, DR halved (round up) + Frosted condition; no save.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Engulf (Recharge 6-8) [Combat]: Surges over one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet. Target makes a Reflex save (compare Agil 4 + Melee Combat 5 vs. save successes). On failure: Grappled, Restrained, takes 3 cold damage per round. Fortitude [Hard] save each round to break free, or an ally can spend 2 [Interact] actions to pull them clear. Water Mastery: In water, ### Attacks against the Wave Breaker add 1 to both dice. Its Crashing Slam reach extends to 15 ft while in water.
